purpose: Post I2V / looklock export 4× upscale hook. Template only — weight path is a PLACEHOLDER; do not commit large weights.

v0_2_strategy.chain: I2V/FLF2V accepted clip → 4× upscale → temporal consistency check → downsample to 1080×1920 → edit

model_choice.rule: pick one for the whole film and freeze it; do not mix per shot

source_sizes.flf2v_720x1280: 2880×5120 after 4×; 2× then 1080 timeline allowed if VRAM/time is tight, label in shot manifest

delivery.downsample: 1920×3328 → 1080×1920; crop ~14px per side or pad 24px top/bottom, choose one and keep consistent

temporal_check.method: sample frames for SSIM / flicker visual check
temporal_check.fail: do not enter the timeline; A/B SeedVR2 3B or FlashVSR (both optional, extra weights) or 2× + mild sharpen
temporal_check.sharpen: mild unsharp + one global grade; no per-shot filter; no over-sharpen halos

v0_2_strategy.naming: v0.2 only after upscale + temporal check + H4 pass; otherwise v0.2-draft / v0.2-limited

upscale_model.approx_bytes_note: ~100MB class; confirm on HF/OpenModelDB before boot

fallback: If Comfy upscale model missing: scripts/upscale_4x.sh --ffmpeg-lanczos (quality lower; still records hook ran)
